s.note: Green Egyptian broad bean falafel with herbs and sesame, with tahini lemon sauce and warm pita
s.how: Soak 250g dried split broad beans overnight. Drain and blitz with an onion, 3 garlic cloves, a bunch each of coriander and parsley, 2 spring onions, cumin, ground coriander, chilli flakes and salt to a coarse green paste and chill. Stir in half a tsp bicarb, shape 20 flat patties and press in sesame. Fry at 175C for 4 minutes until crisp. Serve with tahini whisked with lemon juice and water, and warm pita.

s.note: Spiced lamb kofta on skewers, chargrilled, with cucumber and mint yoghurt
s.how: Soak 12 skewers. Knead 500g lamb mince with a grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, parsley, cumin, paprika, cinnamon, allspice, salt and pepper, mould onto the skewers and chill for 20 minutes. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with squeezed grated cucumber and mint. Brush the kofta with oil and chargrill for 8 minutes, turning, and serve with the yoghurt.

m.note: Sardinian toasted pasta pearls cooked in saffron broth with clams, cherry tomatoes, chilli and parsley
m.how: Purge 1kg clams in salted water for 30 minutes. Heat 800ml fish stock with saffron. Fry 3 sliced garlic cloves and a chilli in 3 tbsp olive oil, add 250g cherry tomatoes and cook until collapsing. Toast 300g fregola in the pan for 2 minutes, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time over 12 minutes. Add the clams, cover and cook for 5 minutes until open. Finish with parsley, lemon zest and the rest of the oil.

w.note: Sardinian fried pastry pockets filled with molten lemon-scented cheese, drenched in warm honey
w.how: Knead 250g plain flour, 40g soft butter, a pinch of salt and 110ml warm water to a smooth dough and rest for 30 minutes. Mix 200g squeezed fior di latte, 50g grated pecorino and a lemon's zest and press into 4 discs. Roll the dough thin, cut 8 rounds of 12cm, sandwich a disc of cheese between two and seal with a fork. Fry in oil at 175C for 3 minutes a side until blistered and golden, drain and pour over 4 tbsp warm honey.

d.note: Sardinian myrtle berry liqueur topped with sparkling wine and soda over ice, with lemon peel and blueberries
d.how: Fill 4 wine glasses with ice. Add 30ml myrtle liqueur to each, top with chilled sparkling wine and a splash of soda, and finish with a twist of lemon peel and 3 blueberries.
